content.rendered:
Wednesday, October 31st, is Halloween and we want to remind everyone of our rules for Halloween costumes:

  • Meets school dress code
  • No masks
  • No face makeup that obscures your face
  • No weapons or replica weapons
  • Nothing that distracts from the learning environment
  • Remember people’s cultures are NOT costumes
  • Please be respectful to everyone!
